session.title: Guided session
session.description: Generates a session plan based on your real stats: current time slot, latest strategy saved on your recent map, and your current form/tilt state.
session.strategyReviewDetail: Head to the Strategy tab to check it before starting your matches.
session.noStrategyDetail: A chance to create one in the Strategy tab before playing.
session.tiltedDetail_one: Reduced goal for today. Take a break after {{count}} match if it doesn't get better.
session.tiltedDetail_other: Reduced goal for today. Take a break after {{count}} matches if it doesn't get better.
session.calmDetail: You can keep playing your matches normally.
session.warmupNoData: Not enough data on this time slot yet ({{slot}}), standard warm-up.

puzzle.title: Daily tactical puzzle
puzzle.description: A real situation pulled from one of your matches, without the outcome. Pick what you would have done, then find out what actually happened. And whether it matches how you play.

puzzle.question: Given this context, what would you have done this round?
puzzle.choiceWas: Your choice ({{choice}}) was classed as "{{bucket}}", your actual play that round was "{{actual}}".

bets.title: Self bets
bets.description: Before starting a session, bet virtually on your performance. The bet resolves itself as soon as your next match shows up in your history.
bets.waitingNextMatch: Waiting for your next match to resolve automatically.

weekly.title: LAST WEEK
weekly.noMatches: No matches last week, the wrap-up will fill in starting next Monday.
weekly.hint: Every Monday, this wrap-up resets and recaps the previous 7 days. Come back here at the start of the week to see your summary and share it if you want.

narrative.overviewNoWinrate: {{gamesText}}, without enough decisive rounds to get a real winrate, a week mostly spent exploring or on side modes.
narrative.overviewGreat: Big week: {{gamesText}}, with {{winrate}}% wins. That kind of run doesn't happen by accident, enjoy it.
narrative.overviewBalanced: Balanced week: {{gamesText}}, {{winrate}}% wins. No dramatic swing either way, just solid play.
narrative.overviewHard: Tougher week: {{gamesText}}, only {{winrate}}% wins. It happens, the important thing is getting back to basics.
narrative.bestMapText: your best map was {{map}} with {{percent}}% winrate
narrative.bestKdText: with a peak of {{kd}} K/D in your best match
narrative.rankFirstSnapshot: Rank-wise, you're currently {{current}}, first snapshot recorded, we'll be able to compare next week.
narrative.rankUnchanged: Your rank didn't move this week: still {{current}}.
narrative.rankDown: Small step back this week: from {{previous}} to {{current}}. Nothing irreversible.
